A1_random_correlated_with_target.attack: Random baseline accidentally correlated with targets

A2_seed_recorded.detail: SEED=42 recorded in plan and script header

A3_future_timestamps_permutation.detail: Permutation operates on targets within split; timestamps not used in permutation

A4_permutation_boundary.detail: Permutation applied separately within each split

A5_ew_future_constituents.detail: Universe defined at evaluation time using historical member lists

A6_benchmark_future_prices.detail: SPY return computed using same date range as strategy; no look-ahead

A7_costs_bypass.detail: Baseline economics computed without costs; strategy must beat baselines net of costs

A8_feature_sneak.attack: Simple predictive baseline silently gains hypothesis-specific features
A8_feature_sneak.detail: Baseline locked to FS-001 (8 approved features); no hypothesis features allowed

A9_degenerate_model.attack: Degenerate model counted as valid baseline

A10_horizon_comparison.detail: Horizon explicitly declared in all baseline configurations

A11_failed_excluded.attack: Failed baseline run excluded from summary
A11_failed_excluded.detail: All runs recorded including failures; no silent exclusion

A12_null_after_candidate.attack: Null distribution calculated after observing candidate result
A12_null_after_candidate.detail: Null baselines established BEFORE any hypothesis testing

A13_purge_defect.attack: Walk-forward purge uses feature boundary instead of outcome window
A13_purge_defect.detail: Purge boundary = train_end - LABEL_HORIZON(5) = train_end - 5 sessions

A14_independence_assumption.attack: Statistical test assumes independence where dependence is known
A14_independence_assumption.detail: Spearman rank IC does not assume independence; serial correlation documented

A15_no_version_update.attack: Baseline implementation changes without version/provenance update
A15_no_version_update.detail: All baselines versioned in plan; changes require new plan digest

A16_overwrite_artifact.detail: ORBIT immutable artifact system prevents silent overwrites
